title: HOPE: Human-Centric Off-Policy Evaluation for E-Learning and Healthcare
reasoning: The paper applies off-policy evaluation to high-stakes human-centric domains (e-learning, healthcare) where poor policies can have negative consequences (e.g., increased mortality, ineffective treatments).
